title: University team assembly handover
scope: Practical handover of E2; no new master engineering review, firmware change or physical release.

sections.title: Actual component identification
instructions: No hardware photographs were supplied in docs/hardware_photos/ at generation. Actual labels and terminal orientation are NOT IDENTIFIED. The following component and port names come from E2, not from observed hardware.

Assign the E2 reference to each physical item with a removable label. Photograph the full item and a readable terminal close-up before terminating a harness. Never infer header order from the picture of another board.
The battery stays unplugged, outside electrical work. Photograph its intact exterior and connector housings only. Do not unwrap the pack, open it or probe its balance pins for identification.

Use the photo request list below. Send original-resolution images with reference names and a ruler where mounting/connector dimensions matter. Add manufacturer datasheets and a terminal-map worksheet; photographs establish only what is visibly marked.

sections.title: Rover top-down layout
instructions: The top-down drawing is a proposed placement plan, not a measured mechanical drawing. FRONT is the sensor/cleaning end. M1/M2 are the left wheel pair, M3/M4 the right pair; M5/M6 brushes and M7 conveyor remain distinct labels.

Dry-fit the chassis, motor mounts, sensor brackets, guarded cleaning head, collection bin and insulated electronics plate. Verify real clearances and photograph the layout before drilling final positions. Do not cut or modify motor leads.

Reserve separate routes for high-current motor/power conductors and logic/sensor harnesses. Mark intended cable routes with string and measure their lengths; leave P1/OV1/OV2/K1/fuse/distribution mounting areas provisional until the actual selected parts fit.
The E2 physical-harness diagram follows the proposed placement drawing. Equal labels describe electrical nets; bundled lines do not establish connector pin order or exact cable lengths.

sections.title: ESP32 connections
instructions: Use GPIO numbers, not a guessed DevKit header position. Confirm ESP32-WROOM-32 and the actual board markings. Record 5V/VIN, 3V3, GND, EN/reset, USB connector and all used GPIO header positions in the terminal-map worksheet.

Keep USB, external supplies and battery disconnected during assembly. A detached signal-interface harness may be prepared after its endpoints and conductor requirements are established. Do not connect MCU power, unknown feedback contacts or real ECHO until their gates close.

E2 GPIOs are unchanged. U1 handles wheel PWM, shared enable and TRIG. GPIO21/22 and 23/25 serve the conditional L298 inputs. All ECHO inputs go through U2; GPIO27 is HIGH healthy through isolated contacts with a pull-down.

For USB-only installation later, disconnect every external power and GPIO harness from the DevKit. Firmware starts disabled; open GPIO27 intentionally latches ESTOP. Do not bridge the feedback HIGH to get past it.

sections.title: Left BTS7960 wiring
instructions: Label this actual module DRV_L. Match every visible label to B+, B-, M+, M-, VCC, GND, RPWM, LPWM, R_EN, L_EN, R_IS and L_IS; unresolved or differently named positions remain unconnected.

M1 left-front and M2 left-rear share M+/M- in parallel, each A lead through its own FM fuse. The motor lead sizes, fuses, B+ branch and B- return remain conditional on load and conductor data; label their ends now without terminating unknown-rated power paths.

RPWM uses U1.18 from GPIO16; LPWM uses U1.16 from GPIO17. Both enable inputs use the hardware-gated shared enable with local pulls. Do not retain hard-HIGH enable links or alter unidentified links by appearance alone.

W046 checks the module's existing B--to-GND bond; it is not a second ground wire. R_IS/L_IS remain separately insulated, unconnected. No current rating is inferred from the BTS7960 name or a module sales claim.

sections.title: Right BTS7960 wiring
instructions: Label this actual module DRV_R and identify its own markings; do not assume it is the same revision or header orientation as DRV_L.

M3 right-front and M4 right-rear share this module's M+/M- in parallel, each A lead through FM3/FM4. Final lead polarity is determined only during later guarded individual-motor tests, never from insulation color.
RPWM uses U1.14 from GPIO18; LPWM uses U1.12 from GPIO19. Both enables use the same physical cutoff path as the left driver, with separate local pulls.
W048 checks the existing B--to-GND bond; do not add a thin parallel return. Keep motor and power terminals isolated until the actual rating, protection and terminal maps have been accepted.

sections.title: L298N cleaning system
instructions: The active E2 proposal is one L298N: IN1/IN2 from GPIO21/22, IN3/IN4 from GPIO23/25, ENA/ENB from the gated shared enable. OUT1/OUT2 feed both brushes M5/M6, with individual FM5/FM6; OUT3/OUT4 feed M7 through FM7.

Identify Vs/+12V, external 5V logic terminal, ground, all control/output labels, separate regulator jumper and ENA/ENB jumpers, regulator part, recirculation diodes and chip marking. E2 Vs_12V/5V_LOGIC are functional port names, not verified printed labels.

Do not attach external 5V until the actual carrier schematic establishes how its onboard regulator must be disabled. Do not confuse that regulator link with the enable jumpers. Keep all cleaning motor power leads unplugged.

Both brushes' currents add on channel A; conveyor current and package heating occur simultaneously on B. Motor voltage/RPM does not establish suitability. If current, delivered voltage or thermal limits fail, follow the conditional replacement/revision instructions in section 12; do not simply reduce software duty.

Both brush directions must sweep inward and conveyor travel must lead into the bin. Mark mechanical arrows now; establish electrical A/B polarity later with approved current-limited tests. Cleaning commands operate only during actual forward travel in the existing firmware.

sections.title: Three HC-SR04 sensors
instructions: Label US_F, US_L and US_R. Photograph each module's actual VCC/TRIG/ECHO/GND order. Front uses GPIO32/34, left 33/35 and right 13/36 for TRIG/ECHO respectively.

Each VCC uses qualified protected logic 5V and each GND the logic return. TRIG comes through U1. Every ECHO uses its own 2.2k upper/3.3k lower divider and then U2; no direct 5V-to-GPIO connection is permitted.

Fit the dividers and local 100nF capacitors on the detached interface assembly. Leave all actual ECHO plugs to the MCU disconnected until raw/divided/buffered waveform, edge-rate and partial-power tests pass.
After electrical qualification, test all three sensors together for fresh valid ranges and acoustic crosstalk. Wokwi's ideal direct ECHO wires and LED indicators are not a physical wiring reference.

sections.title: Logic buffer and ECHO protection
instructions: U1 is SN74AHCT244N, not HC: VCC20 to protected logic5V, GND10 and OE1/OE19 to ground. Preserve the exact pin map shown. R5 is specifically 2.2k at GPIO14/U1.11; other input/default-low resistors follow E2.

U2 is SN74LVC3G34DCU on a verified VSSOP8 carrier: pin8 ONLY to MCU3V3, pin4 to MCU ground, channels 1->7 front, 3->5 left, 6->2 right. A carrier header number is not an IC pin number; continuity-map every header pad before installing the chip or harness.

C_U1/C_U2 are local 100nF bypasses; R30-R32 are 100k U2-output-to-ground pulls. Six separate 10k driver-enable pulls remain at their receivers. Fit each item by reference rather than counting generic resistors.

Unpowered work may include a detached protected interface board, inspection, resistor checks and endpoint labeling after actual package orientation and carrier mapping are known. Keep it disconnected from the ESP32, sensors, drivers and every supply until the applicable checks pass.

Later measurements must establish U2 input HIGH >=2.0V, LOW <=0.8V and <=10ns/V input transitions at the specified 3.3V supply range; verify output levels and absence of unsafe partial-power/backfeed behavior. Do not substitute a generic shifter.

sections.title: Buck converters
instructions: Label BUCK1 MCU and BUCK2 logic; record actual IN+/IN-/OUT+/OUT- markings and module components. W042/W044 are existing negative-bond inspection records, not new jumpers.
Both input branches F1/F2 originate on the protected battery distribution BEFORE K1. They must remain powered when the independent motor contactor opens. Never parallel their positive outputs.

BUCK1 output goes through OV1 to the verified DevKit 5V/VIN input; BUCK2 through OV2 to logic/sensors. OV1/OV2 are required protection/supervision assemblies awaiting real part selection and pin maps; never replace them with wire links.

Later, use an approved current-limited bench source with all loads detached. Adjust each to 5.00V, qualify polarity/load/ripple/temperature/OVP and power-good behavior before attaching electronics. The LM2596 chip headline does not qualify either carrier.

sections.title: Battery protection and distribution
instructions: Prepare mounting space, wire-ID labels and cable-length records now. Keep the battery main and balance connectors unplugged and insulated; do not terminate a battery or balance harness to an unidentified protection board.

E2 topology is BT1 -> F0 adjacent main fuse -> S0 -> high-side cell protection P1 -> TB_POS. Pre-K1 branches feed both bucks and the coil chain; K1's motor bus feeds FL/FR/FA. Return currents use the rated ground star and dedicated heavy branches.

P1 CELL0..3 are electrical potentials, not a balance-connector order. Identify chemistry, cell count, charge limits, discharge capability, source fault envelope and the protection manufacturer's sense wiring before selecting or wiring this assembly.

All fuse currents, conductor gauges, connectors, contact ratings and energy-clamp/reservoir selections remain conditional. Measure harness lengths and installation conditions without cutting motor pigtails. Numeric selection must coordinate actual load/start/fault clearing and smallest conductor/connector capacity.

Expected voltages in the connection register are design expectations, not measured values. The pack maximum of about 12.6V is conditional on ordinary 3S 4.2V-per-cell chemistry; the actual pack is not identified.

sections.title: Emergency-stop wiring
instructions: Select actual DC-rated K1 main NO and two independent NO auxiliaries, suitable coil, S0, latching S2 with three isolated NC functions, S3 momentary NO, suppression and rail-healthy interfaces before wiring their functional ports.

Coil route: FK -> OV1 healthy contact -> OV2 healthy contact -> S2 coil NC -> (S3 NO parallel K1 hold NO) -> K1 coil -> ground. Main K1 NO cuts all three motor branches independently of ESP32 software.

The separate S2 enable NC interrupts U1.9 to all six driver enables. The separate S2 sense NC and K1 sense NO carry MCU3V3 to GPIO27 with its pull-down. LOW is unsafe; no pull-up substitution or shared coil/sense contact is acceptable.

Serial ESTOP/STOP disables firmware outputs but does not open K1 or isolate motor power. With K1 open at boot, GPIO27 LOW intentionally latches ESTOP. Physical release requires verified disabled EN, deliberate hardware power-arm, healthy feedback, RESET, ARM and then explicit motion.

A held/stuck S3 or welded contacts are outside this simple seal-in circuit's fault coverage. Keep the existing E2 HOLD until actual components, risk assumptions, dropout, stored energy and restart tests have evidence. No safety certification is implied.

sections.title: Final component purchase list
instructions: The fixed selections and quantities below come from E2's component model and FINAL_PURCHASE_LIST.md. Buy those identified logic/passive items now; their physical installation still needs package/orientation inspection.

The VSSOP8 adapter/carrier can be specified from U2's known package, but purchase an actual model only after its mechanical drawing, IC-pad map and header map are checked. Labels and insulation supplies may be obtained as ordinary assembly supplies; do not treat them as qualification of power wiring.

The complete conditional purchase table is reproduced from the authoritative E2 list. Do not buy fuses, wire, contactor, clamps, high-current replacement drivers or a BMS from guessed currents or a photograph alone.

L298 replacement is conditional, not selected: E2 identifies two Pololu G2 18v17 #2991 as candidates after load/thermal/protection qualification. A replacement requires a documented design revision, wiring/model/diagrams and adapter/Wokwi semantics checks, not an undocumented swap.

sections.title: Assembly verification checklist
instructions: Start at checkpoint A. A and documented unpowered portions of B/C/D can proceed without the physical power-up HOLD being lifted. An unresolved terminal/rating stops that affected connection, not mounting, labeling or preparing other identified parts.

Recommended order: A -> B with component mapping -> C plus D -> E -> F -> G -> I motor-free cutoff test -> H -> I loaded confirmation -> J. Checkpoint letters organize the work; the independent cutoff must be proven before driver-connected motor testing.

All F-J energized stages are NOT RELEASED in this handover. No missing physical measurement is marked PASS. Supervisor release is per stage and records its evidence; a completed unpowered checklist or virtual test does not authorize battery or motor power.

Use TEAM_ASSEMBLY_RECORD.csv for every one of the 201 records, and TEAM_CHECKPOINT_RECORD.csv for stage sign-off. For each result record instrument/method, actual value and unit, approved limit, inspector/date and photo/trace path. BLANK/PENDING is not PASS.

Send a named evidence batch per checkpoint: overview, readable labels/terminal close-ups, wire-ID/probe endpoint photos for ambiguous or changed routes, complete CSV readings and original scope/thermal/current files for any later powered stage. A photo of a meter without probe endpoints and units cannot establish the measured net.

photo_requests.needed: Front arrow, all mounts, separate cable routes, guarded brush/conveyor clearance, electronics plate dimensions; photograph battery detached.
photo_requests.e2_match: Physical layout only; no hidden wire or terminal inference.

photo_requests.needed: Readable module can/chip/board revision, GPIO and power labels on both headers, EN/reset and USB connector type.
photo_requests.e2_match: Match GPIO16/17/18/19/21/22/23/25/14/27/32/34/33/35/13/36, 3V3/GND and board-approved 5V input. USB power path needs schematic, not just photos.

photo_requests.needed: Chip/buffer markings, control header order and all screw labels, jumpers/links, connectors and heatsink mounting. Do not dismantle powered equipment.
photo_requests.e2_match: B+/B-/M+/M-/VCC/GND/RPWM/LPWM/R_EN/L_EN/R_IS/L_IS, orientation and link configuration; no continuous-current inference.

photo_requests.needed: Same independent views as DRV_L; include this board's own labels and revision.
photo_requests.e2_match: Match this module separately; identify internal B-/GND bond by later unpowered method.

photo_requests.needed: Chip/regulator markings, Vs/5V/GND, OUT1-4, IN1-4, ENA/ENB labels, separate regulator jumper and all recirculation diodes.
photo_requests.e2_match: Map actual carrier labels to E2 Vs_12V and 5V_LOGIC functional ports; schematic and thermal/load data still required.

photo_requests.needed: Each sensor face/rear and readable VCC/TRIG/ECHO/GND labels, version and mounting direction; paired views may share a photo if legible.
photo_requests.e2_match: Three individual header maps; visual appearance does not prove ECHO levels.

photo_requests.needed: Each actual IN+/IN-/OUT+/OUT-, chip, inductor, diode, capacitor voltage markings and adjustment screw.
photo_requests.e2_match: MCU versus logic designation and polarity; internal negative bond and capability need measurement/data.

photo_requests.needed: Each distinct label/part number, rated voltage/speed if printed, gearbox, pigtails/connectors and mechanical direction arrow. Conveyor is a priority.
photo_requests.e2_match: Assign motor identities and lead labels A/B provisionally. No operating/start/stall current or direction inferred from color/RPM.

photo_requests.needed: Intact exterior chemistry/cell/capacity/C-rating/charge information and manufacturer; unplugged main/balance housings without exposing or probing contacts.
photo_requests.e2_match: Confirm actual pack specification. Balance pin order must follow manufacturer data; do not unwrap or open battery.

photo_requests.needed: IC order code and pin1, actual carrier model/header markings, resistor reference/value labels, divider nodes, bypass placement and solder joints.
photo_requests.e2_match: Verify AHCT244N and LVC3G34DCU, IC-to-carrier mapping and MCU3V3 supply for U2; attach header continuity map.

photo_requests.references: P1 / OV1 / OV2 / K1 / S0 / S2 / S3
photo_requests.files: P10_<reference>_label_terminals.jpg for each actual selected assembly
photo_requests.needed: Manufacturer/part/revision, complete terminal legends, coil/contact blocks and markings; attach maker datasheet and a function-to-terminal mapping.
photo_requests.e2_match: These assemblies are unselected E2 functional ports; photographs alone do not close ratings, thresholds, isolated contact or reset behavior.

photo_requests.references: F0 / F1 / F2 / FK / FL / FR / FA / FM1-7 / TB_POS / TB_GND / clamps / capacitors / harness
photo_requests.needed: Actual fuse/holder series and rating/curve references, wire/connector markings, capacitor/clamp codes and polarity, mounting and conductor-length schedule.
photo_requests.e2_match: Match approved selections only after current/thermal/fault criteria exist; unmarked parts remain unidentified.

photo_requests.needed: Unpowered overview, each terminal strip close-up, both ends of labeled harnesses; probe endpoints and instrument display for ambiguous/changed routes. Provide a reading row for every connection, not 201 repetitive photos.
photo_requests.e2_match: Tie every measurement and photo to wire IDs/checkpoint; preserve originals and explain any deviation.

measurements.required: Board manufacturer/revision, every used printed terminal and orientation; U1/U2 package-to-adapter map; correct links/regulator mode; maker schematics for DevKit, BTS, L298 and bucks.
measurements.acceptance: One-to-one E2 functional-port to actual printed terminal map, readable photos/datasheets. Unreadable/unmarked terminal remains unconnected.

measurements.required: Chemistry, cell count, charge/discharge limits, continuous/peak C and duration, condition, main/balance connector identification and manufacturer sense order; fault envelope from documented data, never a battery short test.
measurements.acceptance: P1, charger, contact/fuse voltage/current and sense wiring selected against actual pack limits, not nominal 11.1V alone.

measurements.stage: D data first; H later approved isolated tests
measurements.required: For each M1-M7: part/rated voltage and permitted range, load/run current, start peak and duration, stall current and permitted duration, insulation/pigtail limits; conveyor voltage specifically. Use manufacturer data or separately approved low-energy characterization, never hand-held stalling.
measurements.acceptance: Voltage and RMS/run/start/stall envelopes fit motor, driver, connector and coordinated cutoff limits; missing current profile prevents final power selection.

measurements.stage: D data / E selection; H later confirmation
measurements.required: M1+M2, M3+M4 and M5+M6 totals, simultaneous M7 demand; documented board derating, delivered motor voltage, diode capacity, ambient/case/heatsink temperatures and thermal path; start/stall clearing limits.
measurements.acceptance: All continuous/pulse/thermal/voltage limits met simultaneously with stated margin; L298 failing any limit triggers a reviewed replacement revision.

measurements.required: Each branch/pigtail material/size/connector rating, one-way route length, ambient/bundling, allowed voltage drop, start/fault I-squared-t and source DC interruption envelope; contactor main/inrush/break and coil voltage/current range across loaded pack.
measurements.acceptance: Fuse clearing precedes smallest protected lead/motor/driver allowable overload; voltage drop/temperature acceptable; contacts and holders documented for DC service. No guessed AWG or fuse amperage.

measurements.required: Record test-lead resistance; each external segment end-to-end ohms, neighboring-net isolation and polarity with intended sensitive electronics detached; inspect four existing bonds separately. Identify any semiconductor path in context.
measurements.acceptance: Expected path agrees with conductor/lead budget, no unintended cross-net link; lead-resistance-corrected values reviewed. Never megger connected electronics or meter resistance across a live battery.

measurements.required: Each buck output no-load/peak load, startup/turn-off peak, ripple, temperature and OVP/OCP/UV/power-good response over approved input range; raw and protected outputs separately, dummy loads first.
measurements.acceptance: 5.00V target; protected healthy envelope 4.75-5.25V or tighter actual part limits, rated peak load/heat, fail-open coil-permissive response verified. Scope fast peaks; do not intentionally expose MCU to a buck fault.

measurements.item: ECHO, enable, reset and partial power
measurements.required: Raw/divided/U2-output HIGH/LOW, overshoot, rise/fall rate under actual harness, MCU/logic rail order and backfeed, GPIO14 and all six enables through boot/reset/brownout, summed receiver loads.
measurements.acceptance: U2 input HIGH >=2.0V, LOW <=0.8V, 0-5.5V and <=10ns/V edges at specified VCC; GPIO levels within ESP32 limits; no unsafe EN pulse/backfeed or raw 5V GPIO path. Use isolated test fixtures before MCU attachment.

measurements.stage: I only after release; repeat after H
measurements.required: K1 dropout/coil range, stop-contact continuity, enable fall, bus residual voltage/discharge, normal manual reset sequence, held-reset/weld limitations, suppression and worst braking/regeneration peak/energy.
measurements.acceptance: Physical S2 removes all motor power independently of firmware, opens enable and drives GPIO27 LOW; release alone with S3 released does not restart. Clamp/reservoir and discharge/stopping limits supported by reviewed data/traces.

measurements.required: Each motor direction and permitted low-energy current, paired run/starting profiles and heat, brush inward sweep/conveyor transport, sensor/crosstalk ranges, actual speed/stopping distance at worst intended floor/load and supervision envelope.
measurements.acceptance: Physical directions correct, currents/heat inside approved limits; no auto restart, safe distance margin and guards; controller/simulation results alone never satisfy these measurements.

checkpoints.title: Unpowered mounting and labeling
checkpoints.state: AVAILABLE: dry-fit and label, no electrical power
checkpoints.prerequisites: All battery main/balance connectors, USB and bench sources disconnected; motor ends isolated. Use an unpowered chassis/plate; keep battery detached and protected.
instructions: Mark FRONT and label ESP1, DRV_L/R/A, BUCK1/2, US_F/L/R, M1-M7 and planned protection positions.
Dry-fit mounts and guards with clearance for moving parts; do not drill into/near a battery or unknown wiring. Photograph with a ruler and measure harness routes with string.

Print both-end wire-ID labels for the 197 external segments only. Mark the four internal-bond inspection IDs on the module worksheet, not on new wires. Preserve pigtails/colors; leave current-dependent circuits unterminated.
checkpoints.photos: P00 layout/underside/ruler; P07 motor mounts; overview showing detached battery and unplugged sources.
checkpoints.measurements: Mount/hole/plate dimensions, guard and sensor clearance, one-way cable-route lengths; no powered electrical measurement in A.
checkpoints.pass: All actual items labeled, mechanical fit documented, separate routing possible, no powered connection; unknown parts have reserved space rather than guessed terminals.
checkpoints.stop: Any supply attached, damaged battery/pigtail, interference/pinch hazard, obscured labels or drilling near unknown cables; stop affected mounting and resolve.
checkpoints.send: A batch: P00/P07 images, reference inventory, layout with FRONT arrow, dimension/route-length sheet, list of missing items.

checkpoints.title: Protected signal-interface assembly
checkpoints.state: UNPOWERED ONLY: after fixed parts and carrier map verified
checkpoints.prerequisites: A done; correct U1/U2 and passive values available; actual package pin1 and adapter-to-IC mapping inspected. Interface remains detached from all modules and supplies.
instructions: Lay out U1 and U2 with local C_U1/C_U2; fit reference-labeled bias networks, R5 specifically 2.2k, three ECHO dividers and R30-R32 100k output pulls.
Keep divider-to-U2 nodes short. Label U2 pin8 MCU3V3 so it cannot be mistaken for logic5V; separate input/output connectors by documented pin maps.
Inspect top and underside for bridges, correct upper/lower divider routing and supply/ground polarity. Do not change E2 values or use a generic level shifter.
checkpoints.photos: P09 IC markings/pin1, carrier both sides, complete top/underside with reference labels; ruler/trace layout.
checkpoints.measurements: Resistor values before installation or interpreted with parallel paths; adapter/header continuity, supply-to-ground isolation, divider and OE-to-ground mapping. No voltage applied.
checkpoints.pass: All fixed parts match E2, U1/U2 orientation and every adapter pad mapped; resistor/reference and supply routing verified with no unintended shorts.
checkpoints.stop: Unknown chip/package, unverified carrier map, wrong/missing resistor, raw ECHO bypass, U2 powered from logic5V in layout, solder bridge or unresolved low-resistance path.
checkpoints.send: B batch: P09 photos, carrier pin-map worksheet, passive-value/continuity readings, solder inspection and any deviation marked unresolved.

checkpoints.title: Unpowered wiring and continuity checks
checkpoints.state: AVAILABLE FOR IDENTIFIED SEGMENTS; unresolved routes stay open
checkpoints.prerequisites: A/B applicable checks done; actual endpoint labels mapped for each segment; conductor/connector requirements established for that segment. All sources and motor loads remain detached.
instructions: Build only identified, appropriately specified detached signal segments and mount/connect accepted passive interface parts. Label both ends with wire ID, net and terminal.
Leave battery/balance, all motor outputs and high-current branches, unselected safety ports, external buck/MCU power and all actual ECHO-to-MCU paths unconnected. Prepare their labels/lengths only.
Record each of 197 external segment checks without populating missing parts with links. Check W042/W044/W046/W048 as internal bonds; add no wire for them.
Use low-energy meter continuity/ohms with sensitive electronics detached; trace end-to-end and adjacent nets, not just a continuity buzzer. Preserve separately insulated NC pins.
checkpoints.photos: P12_C_overview and each terminal-strip/harness close-up; both end labels; probe endpoints/display for ambiguous or changed wire IDs.
checkpoints.measurements: D06 for each completed segment; four internal-bond results separate. Record lead resistance, actual ohms, expected limit and interpretation; no megger on electronics.
checkpoints.pass: Completed subset agrees with register/netlist and verified maps, no cross-net shorts; open pending routes explicitly tagged and logged. Unpowered progress can PASS for that subset without releasing power.
checkpoints.stop: Unidentified pin, unset power-wire rating, missing protection, unexpected bond/short/polarity, untraceable splice, or any connected supply; stop that route, isolate and report.
checkpoints.send: C batch: TEAM_ASSEMBLY_RECORD.csv with completed/pending rows, terminal maps, harness photos and explicit unresolved wire-ID list.

checkpoints.title: Physical component identification and measurements
checkpoints.state: LABELS/DATASHEETS AND UNPOWERED METHODS ONLY NOW
checkpoints.prerequisites: Reference labels assigned; source isolation maintained. Powered current/ripple/thermal characterization is a later separately released test, not authorized by this checkpoint.
instructions: Collect P01-P11 images and manufacturer documents; fill functional-port-to-actual-terminal maps. Prioritize battery identity, conveyor voltage and all motor part numbers.
Collect D01-D06 data: ratings/current profiles from datasheets, harness geometry, permitted limits and unpowered continuity. Mark missing values PENDING rather than guessing from appearance or RPM.

If motor start/stall data is unavailable, obtain a supervised low-energy characterization plan with known voltage/current/duration limits before any such test. Never short-test the battery or hold a stalled gearbox by hand.
checkpoints.photos: All requested component identification views P01-P11, legible part/revision and actual terminal markings; no internal battery disassembly.
checkpoints.measurements: Manufacturer motor run/start/stall and thermal limits; pack C/cell/chemistry data; cable/pigtail/connector geometry and unpowered bonds. D07-D10 remain future gated measurements.
checkpoints.pass: Each affected selection has traceable exact-part data or an explicitly accepted future measurement plan; missing data and affected routes clearly listed. Energized gates remain pending.
checkpoints.stop: Unreadable/unmatched board, unknown conveyor voltage, missing safe measurement limits, unexplained module links, damaged pack or temptation to infer current from a photo.
checkpoints.send: D batch: P01-P11 originals, manufacturer PDFs, terminal mapping, completed/remaining D01-D06 worksheet and current_budget.csv values with evidence.

checkpoints.title: Component-dependent electrical completion
checkpoints.state: HOLD: actual selection and mappings required; completion remains unpowered
checkpoints.prerequisites: D provides load/source/installation evidence; reviewed actual P1/OV1/OV2/K1/S0/S2/S3, fuse/wire/connector, clamp/reservoir and driver selections. Any replacement requires a recorded design revision first.
instructions: Select parts against approved load/start/stall/thermal/fault data and populate exact manufacturer terminal maps; no arbitrary fuse/contactor/TVS/BMS substitution.

Finish accepted harness branches while isolated, including heavy star returns, protection placements, independent coil/enable/sense contacts and verified module link settings. Keep battery connectors, actual motor loads and MCU/ECHO power harnesses detached for initial tests.
Repeat per-wire and adjacent-net checks; update the physical as-built record and have any topology/pin/value deviation explicitly reviewed against E2 before it is used.
checkpoints.photos: P10/P11 actual selections and markings, fuse/holder/terminal installation, every safety contact block, complete top/underside and revised terminal maps.
checkpoints.measurements: Selection calculations D02-D05, unpowered continuity/insulation/contact truth states, maker torque/crimp requirements and allowed conductor sizes.
checkpoints.pass: No generic functional port remains guessed on completed circuits; ratings coordinated, driver arrangement qualified on data, complete as-built mapping and continuity accepted for the intended next test only.
checkpoints.stop: Unselected current-dependent part, missing protection or feedback contact, regulator/jumper conflict, overload/thermal failure, guessed balance order or undocumented design deviation.
checkpoints.send: E batch: approved BOM/rating calculations/datasheets, as-built terminal and connection records, protection/contact photos, explicit outstanding stage gates.

checkpoints.title: USB-only firmware installation
checkpoints.state: NOT RELEASED: future isolated DevKit procedure
checkpoints.prerequisites: D identifies actual DevKit/cable/port; supervisor has accepted a USB-only plan and source identity. Completely detach every external GPIO and power harness, battery/balance and motor wiring from the DevKit.
instructions: Build esp32dev from the reviewed E2 source and record commit/hash/target. Use a confirmed data-capable cable matching the actual connector; do not guess its type from this package.
Upload only to the isolated board under the separately released procedure; record upload log. Open monitor at 115200 baud with LF and verify disabled startup.
With GPIO27 open, ESTOP latching is expected. Do not jumper it HIGH or send movement commands to defeat the feedback design. Disconnect USB before reattaching any external harness.
checkpoints.photos: DevKit alone with every external connector detached; USB/board identification and monitor log capture.
checkpoints.measurements: Recorded source/firmware identity, upload target/port and disabled startup/feedback status; any board voltage check only as allowed by the released isolated plan.
checkpoints.pass: Reviewed firmware installed on identified isolated board, startup disabled and no external backfeed path; reconnecting external hardware is not released by this PASS.
checkpoints.stop: Any external harness remains, unknown USB connector/board, upload mismatch, unexpected enabled startup, or attempt to bypass feedback.
checkpoints.send: F batch: detached-board photo, commit/build/upload logs, serial startup log and operator/date; preserve older installed firmware status until this is actually done.

checkpoints.title: Regulated power testing
checkpoints.state: NOT RELEASED: staged current-limited bench tests only after evidence
checkpoints.prerequisites: E accepted for intended test; F if MCU will be used; exact schematic, current limits, test points, dummy loads and supervisor release documented. Battery and motor loads remain disconnected; no mixed USB/external supply until qualified.
instructions: Test each detached buck and selected protector independently with approved isolated/current-limited source and dummy load. Set 5.00V and document polarity/load/ripple/temperature and protection behavior before attaching electronics.

Qualify U1/U2/sensor and enable interfaces on safe test fixtures, including reset/rail-order/backfeed/edge behavior, before connecting real GPIOs. Leave actual ECHO-to-MCU plugs open until interface acceptance.
Attach only the specifically accepted electronics at each substep. Record scope rails and all six enables; a rail issue or unreviewed power-order change cancels that substep.
checkpoints.photos: Source current limit and wiring, dummy load/test-point labels, each buck/protector, isolated interface fixture; scope probe points and settings.
checkpoints.measurements: D07/D08: rail no-load/load/ripple/peaks/heat/protection, ECHO logic/edges, partial power and reset/default-low enable traces; original instrument files.
checkpoints.pass: All intended loads meet their documented rail/logic limits and protected supply response, no unsafe backfeed/enable glitch; accepted substeps recorded. Battery/motor tests remain separately gated.
checkpoints.stop: Wrong polarity, output outside accepted envelope, OVP/PG failure, unsafe EN pulse, raw 5V GPIO path, unexpected heat/backfeed or unknown current limit.
checkpoints.send: G batch: wiring/current-limit photos, measured table, original scope captures, ripple/load/thermal/protection records and accepted substep list.

checkpoints.title: Individual motor testing
checkpoints.state: NOT RELEASED: approved low-energy tests; cutoff first for driver tests
checkpoints.prerequisites: Known motor voltage and permitted current/duration/thermal limits; guarded restraints/lifted wheels and supervised plan. G and I motor-free cutoff test must PASS before any driver-connected motor trial. Battery remains disconnected unless separately released later.
instructions: Test one mechanically guarded motor at a time using approved current-limited bench energy, verified protection and current measurement setup. Do not insert a meter across a supply or hand-stall a gearbox.

Record direction at approved short pulses; isolate before changing A/B leads. Confirm all wheel forward arrows, inward brush sweep and conveyor-to-bin movement. Preserve reference and polarity records.

Only after individual envelopes pass, qualify summed wheel pairs and simultaneous cleaning demand under the reviewed plan; record start/run profiles, delivered voltage and temperatures. An unknown stall duration is a stop condition, not a test target.
checkpoints.photos: Each motor ID, restraints/guards, polarity and current-probe setup; direction video and mechanical path.
checkpoints.measurements: D03/D04/D10 as released: actual voltage, start peak/duration, run/load current and thermal rise; compare with approved driver/motor/fuse/lead limits. Stall data by accepted method only.
checkpoints.pass: Directions and each measured operating envelope within approved limits; pair/cleaning qualification specifically documented before combined use. Any L298 failure leaves cleaning disconnected.
checkpoints.stop: No I motor-free PASS for driver-connected trials, unknown voltage/limits, jam, opposing wheel/brush direction, overcurrent/overheat, voltage sag or failed shutdown; isolate source.
checkpoints.send: H batch: per-motor/pair/cleaning tables, current/time/thermal originals, polarity updates, guarded direction videos and any required driver-revision proposal.

checkpoints.title: Emergency-stop testing
checkpoints.state: NOT RELEASED: motor-free preflight before H; loaded confirmation afterward
checkpoints.prerequisites: E/G accepted, actual contactor/contacts/suppression and limits documented, current-limited test source plus safe dummy load. All motors disconnected for first cutoff test. Loaded confirmation requires H acceptance.
instructions: First test the physical coil/enable/sense chain using a safe dummy load, independently of firmware. Prove K1-open boot, manual power-arm, S2 interruption and GPIO27 truth states.

Measure dropout, motor-bus discharge and all enable states; release S2 with S3 released and verify no automatic reseal. Verify serial ESTOP only disables firmware outputs and leaves K1 bus electrically distinct.

Before H, record motor-free cutoff acceptance. After H, repeat under the approved motor/load envelope for regeneration/stopping and stored energy; document held-S3/welded-contact limitations rather than claiming fault tolerance.
checkpoints.photos: Complete labeled contact chain, separate coil/enable/sense contacts, source/dummy load, scope points; later guarded stop video.
checkpoints.measurements: D09: coil range, dropout/enable/feedback timing, residual voltage/discharge, normal reset sequence and clamping/braking peaks against approved limits.
checkpoints.pass: All motor branches removed independently of MCU, enables interrupted, GPIO27 LOW unsafe, no restart on S2 release alone with S3 released; measured response/energy within accepted limits. Record motor-free and loaded outcomes separately.
checkpoints.stop: Any powered branch survives S2 unexpectedly, false HIGH feedback, missing independent contact, automatic reseal, unsafe stored energy/clamp/dropout, or unsupported risk assumption.
checkpoints.send: I batch: contact maps, dummy-load preflight record before H, original timing/voltage traces, reset-sequence video and later loaded confirmation; no current result is prefilled PASS.

checkpoints.title: Complete autonomous operation
checkpoints.state: NOT RELEASED: all earlier physical gates and supervised trial plan required
checkpoints.prerequisites: A-I accepted for actual as-built configuration, H summed-load and I loaded results closed, installed firmware identity known, guards/controlled area/physical-stop operator present. Battery use requires its own accepted pack/protection/charger and power-up evidence.
instructions: Begin with the reviewed controlled first-power procedure and low-speed supervised trials, clear area and stop operator. Verify three fresh ranges and physical stop before movement.

Explicit RESET/ARM/AUTO only under the accepted plan; verify forward/turn/avoidance, bounded recovery, independent cleaning while forward, sensor faults, manual timeout and no restart after stop/reset.

Measure actual speed/stopping margin on intended floor/load. Keep operations supervised until the documented physical envelope and all acceptance limits have been demonstrated; record faults instead of bypassing interlocks.
checkpoints.photos: Complete as-built top/underside, all guards/covers, battery protection installation, test area and accessible physical stop; continuous trial video.
checkpoints.measurements: D10 plus full-system rail/pack sag, current/thermal/regeneration and stopping-distance records under worst intended approved conditions; sensor freshness/crosstalk and stop/restart logs.
checkpoints.pass: All physical acceptance limits met, no unresolved safety/protection/thermal/wiring hold for this configuration, correct garbage collection directions and bounded autonomous behavior under the stated supervised envelope.
checkpoints.stop: Any previous gate pending, person/obstacle risk, stale sensor, runaway/restart, loose harness/guard, overcurrent/heat/rail fault or unexplained discrepancy; use physical stop and isolate.
checkpoints.send: J batch: final as-built photos/records, installed commit/hash, trial logs/video, quantitative speed/current/heat/stop data and signed configuration-specific verdict.
